versionPairs.description: A real, minified Bun 1.3.14 build (`bun build bin/cli.js --target=bun --format=cjs --minify`) of an app written in CommonJS: a bin that only requires the app, 52 app modules that all read the app's version from its own package.json, and one library that declares itself by banner (exp172). Bun wraps every module, app or library, in `__commonJS`; the app's own modules stay in the app (src/), the library is vendored. v1.1.0 bumps the version and changes one app module's output.
